verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Sprinto serves an llms.txt index at docs.sprinto.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). The docs also offer markdown versions of pages that point to llms.txt as the complete documentation index, so an agent can read the docs directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, and no independent hands-on report of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
